messages:
maria: ok team — launching sparse-kernel v1.3.0 (sparse-matmul plugin) tonight 02:30 UTC. need quick preflight thumbs and release-note bullets. rolling in 4 buckets (stripe-based). shout if blocker.
raj: LGTM on staging perf. saw a small p95 bump on long-seq (≈+4ms). filed issue #4321.
jen: can we enable a runtime fallback to dense-matmul by default for the first run? last time that saved us.
maria: yes, runtime.feature.sparse_fallback=true for first 24h. will include in rollout config.
deploybot: deploybot: rollback-safe rollout scheduled for 1728769200 (02:30 UTC) — buckets: 2%,10%,30%,100%. healthchecks: ok -> will report per-bucket.
sam: @maria oncall: i'll watch eviction metrics + OOM. ping me if mem spikes. :eyes:
raj: note — quant build for this commit is disabled; we shouldn't mix quant artifacts until perf signoff.
jen: release notes draft at /docs/releases/2026-03-sparse-kernel.md. bullets: perf, fallback flag, config, rollback steps.
maria: rollback criteria (agreed): p95 > +8ms sustained 15m OR error rate >0.5% OR mem >90% for 10m -> cut traffic back two buckets and hold.
sam: ack. i'll run the smoke script after each bucket: `./scripts/smoke_sparse.sh` — will paste logs if any fail.
raj: if hotfix needed we'll prepare dense-only build and cherry-pick fixes. no live hotpatching unless trivial and reviewed.
deploybot: deploybot: bucket 2 healthcheck failed @1728765488 — 502 spike for ~30s, auto-rollback to bucket1 triggered. escalating to @maria @sam.
maria: on it, pulling traces. sam please stop traffic and hold. jen please update release notes and mark incident.
jen: updating notes + opening postmortem thread. adding links to telemetry graphs.
sam: stopped traffic. quick look: KV-cache miss storm on nodes with older AVX drivers. draining those nodes now.
maria: plan: re-run with fallback=true and exclude problematic nodes from bucket. will do adhoc canary on healthy nodes only.
deploybot: deploybot: redeploy scheduled to bucket1 with fallback=true @1728765555. monitoring.
raj: p95 back to baseline on the fallback canary. will keep 30m watch.
maria: thanks. next steps: merge final release notes, tag the fix. if root cause needs code change we'll cut v1.3.1 with the driver-safe workaround.
jen: noted; postmortem + RN update in progress. :white_check_mark:
deploybot: deploybot: monitoring green across canary after fallback; closing alert if stable for 30m.
